summary: Frontend-only regression of the security hardening (cookie session + CSRF, WS ticket, object-storage uploads, password policy, OAuth error toasts). 9 of 10 requested flows work: crew login sets an HttpOnly tdl_session cookie and tdl_token is not in localStorage, the session survives a reload, the availability toggle POSTs with X-CSRF-Token and gets 200, photo upload saves to /api/public/files/... and the image renders, logout clears the cookies and protected routes redirect to /auth, the contractor dashboard and Post Job modal load, super admin Users and Analytics load, JSON and CSV export download with toasts, and the Export tab is hidden for a normal admin. A weak password is rejected client-side and a strong one registers and lands on /crew/dashboard. WebSocket URLs are /api/ws?ticket=... with no JWT, and there is no infinite reconnect loop. Issues found: (1) the dashboard WS status stays 'Connecting...' even though a socket is open; (2) the oauth_failed toast does not show when /auth?error=oauth_failed is loaded directly (it does show after client-side navigation, which is what AuthCallback does); (3) some older images are broken because their URLs are /uploads/... paths, which reach the frontend and return HTML.

minor.issue: Older users' DB records still point to /uploads/logos/... and /uploads/profile_photos/... (e.g. contractor1 logo, micah.rowland photo). Paths without /api go to the frontend, which returns text/html, so avatars show broken-image icons on the contractor dashboard and navbar. The files still exist in /app/backend/uploads. Not caused by this change, but the move to object storage did not migrate them.

The backend sets SameSite=lax, but the response the browser receives says 'SameSite=None; Partitioned' for tdl_session. The preview ingress probably rewrites HttpOnly cookies. tdl_csrf stays Lax. Production should be checked; the double-submit CSRF check still protects state-changing requests.

ui_bugs.issue: The status shows 'Connecting...' permanently (checked again after 12s) even though a WS is open. Cause: under React.StrictMode the effect runs twice, so connect() runs twice and 2 tickets and 2 sockets are created. The backend closes the older socket with code 4000, and that socket's onclose calls setConnected(false) without checking whether it is still ws.current. Fix: keep a local `const sock = new WebSocket(...)` and do nothing in onopen/onclose/onerror if `ws.current !== sock`. Also, after the ticket await, re-check `ws.current && ws.current.readyState <= 1` (CONNECTING or OPEN) to avoid a second socket. Optionally do not reconnect on close code 4000 (replaced).

Loading /auth?error=oauth_failed directly as a full page shows no toast. Cause: <Toaster> is rendered after <AppRoutes/> in App.js, so AuthPage's mount effect calls toast.error before the Toaster subscribes. Client-side navigation (how AuthCallback redirects) does show it, but twice under StrictMode. Fix: move <Toaster/> above <AppRoutes/> or wrap the call in setTimeout(...,0), and pass {id: 'oauth-error'} to avoid duplicates.

issues: Password placeholders still say 'Min 6 characters' (auth-password-input, reset-password-input), but the policy is now 8-72 characters with upper, lower, digit and symbol. Update the placeholder or add a hint.

handleLogout calls navigate('/') but the user ends up on /auth, because ProtectedRoute redirects first when user becomes null. Behavior is unchanged from before (not a regression); the request expected the landing page.
'Crew: 4' label and legend are #0000FF on a dark background, so contrast is low.
Uses the browser's native datetime-local pickers instead of the shadcn calendar (not caused by this change).

action_items: Fix the stale 'Connecting...' WS status in WebSocketContext.jsx: ignore events from sockets that are no longer ws.current, and avoid creating two sockets under StrictMode.
Make the OAuth error toast show on a direct full-page load: render <Toaster/> before <AppRoutes/> or defer the toast, and give it an id to avoid duplicates.
Migrate legacy '/uploads/...' profile_photo and logo URLs to object storage (/api/public/files/...), or serve them under /api/uploads.
Update the password input placeholders to match the new policy.
critical_code_review_comments: WebSocketContext.connect: the guard `ws.current?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN` misses the CONNECTING state and the time spent waiting for the ticket, so concurrent calls create duplicate sockets; old sockets' onclose handlers then overwrite the connected state.
AdminDashboard ExportTab uses fetch with credentials:'include' (GET), which is fine for CSRF since it is a GET.
AuthContext calls localStorage.removeItem('tdl_token') at module load, which is good cleanup for old tokens.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (9/10 requested flows passed; oauth toast on direct load failed; WS status indicator incorrect)
